research.summary: SUSE Enterprise Storage is a distributed, Ceph-based software-defined storage solution. SUSE publishes an explicit lifecycle table with per-version GA and End of Life dates.
research.notes: Tier: researched (AGENTS.md rule 8b). endoflife.date has no suse-enterprise-storage slug (checked https://endoflife.date/api/all.json 2026-09-17) and data/products/ holds no suse-enterprise-storage record. SUSE publishes an explicit lifecycle table at https://www.suse.com/lifecycle/ with per-version GA and End of Life dates. Month-precision GA entries (December 2021, July 2021) are stored as months where the source gives no day; day-precision dates are stored as days. The 4.2.x and earlier row gives 'March 2021 (last)' as GA and 'May 2022' as EOL — GA is not a single release date but the last release of that line, so ga stays null; eol is stored as month 2022-05. The EOL quote is day-precision and the month-precision EOL for 4.2.x is excluded from the day-precision OpenEoX export, enumerated under v1/openeox/index.json exclusions. eos/eossec not stated by vendor, remain null. A minimum of 2 years from date of release is the stated support policy.
